Remark
[Simplifying Lipschitz hypothesis] ↗ def:c1-functional-class-hilbert 1. ch8:8.5.1-rem-1\group Critical Point Theory

The simplifying hypothesis used here is \[ I' : H \to H \text{ is Lipschitz continuous on bounded subsets of } H. \tag {2} \]

Let $\mathcal C$ be the class of functionals $I\in C^1(H;\R )$ satisfying (2), and for $c\in \R $ set \[ A_c:=\{ u\in H\mid I[u]\leq c\} , \qquad K_c:=\{ u\in H\mid I[u]=c,\ I'[u]=0\} . \]
